# Annual Leave

Annual leave is paid time off for rest and personal plans. Full-time employees receive 20
days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

## Booking annual leave

Requests are submitted at least 10 working days in advance and are reviewed by the employee's
manager. Up to 5 unused days carry forward and must be used before 31 March.

## Sickness during leave

If an employee becomes sick while on annual leave, the affected days may be converted to
sick leave when a medical certificate is provided.
